04-25-1363 is April 25, 1363.  
12 weeks = 84 days. Plus 5 days = 89 days added.  
April 25 + 89 days: April has 30 days, so April 25 → May 20 (5 days left in April, then 30 days in May, 31 in June, 31 in July → too far). Let's calculate:  

Days remaining in April: 30 - 25 = 5 days.  
89 - 5 = 84 days left.  
May: 31 days → 84 - 31 = 53 left.  
June: 30 days → 53 - 30 = 23 left.  
July: 23 days → July 23, 1363.
